title: Bushey Whitley Memorial
memorial_details: Information board in a rural location near the crash site.
narrative: On the night of 2 September 1943, Whitley AD679 of 81 Operational Training Unit departed Sleap at 2015 on a Bullseye exercise — a training flight designed to simulate a bombing raid. The pilot was believed to have been dazzled by searchlights, causing severe evasive manoeuvres that overstressed the mainplanes and caused in-flight structural failure. The aircraft crashed at approximately 2215. All five crew were killed.
cause_of_loss: In-flight structural failure following evasive action after pilot dazzled by searchlights

sources.title: Chorley, W.R. — Bomber Command Losses Vol. 7
